title: German Festive Bhuna Roll
description: A German-inspired dish featuring a festive bhuna roll filled with a rich egg mixture.
instructions: Unroll the festive roll and place it on a baking sheet.
In a bowl, mix together the bhuna and beaten egg.
Spread the bhuna-egg mixture evenly onto the center of the roll, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the roll over the filling to form a rectangular shape.
Brush the top of the roll with the buttery.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
